scope: Forward HERO only. No physical features before committed controls and numbered access. Synthetic checks are pure finite categorical arrays, never physical lattice samples. CPU one thread. Training reads fit and tune only, never rule or assessment; no temperature/mobility/motif/cavity labels or inventory in either branch.
geometry: Lex z,y,x; ternary V=27 only; ternary E=386 only. Two lossless indicator channels [vacancy,A] centered at fixed [.25,.30]. No rotations, no scalar invariance claimed. All affine maps include bias. Centers: affine 54->4 or tanh 54->16->4; critic identical tanh 772->16->4; Xavier-scale Gaussian weights and zero biases. K=4.
sampling: Each update uses 8 groups of 8 different parents (7 negative candidates per anchor), exchanging all eight positions as positives so shell is evaluated once. Unconditional uniform parent, uniform anchor. Conditional stratum S=((Nv//3)*8+NA//4)*8+occupied_internal_54_NN_edges//8; choose S proportional to number of available anchors, restricted to strata with >=8 distinct parents; choose eight uniform support parents without replacement, then a uniform eligible anchor within each. Same law for positives and negatives (not an anchor-frequency weighted parent choice). Independent parents subject to the distinctness constraint; finite bank and empirical stratum conditioning means this is a sampled finite-candidate contrastive bound estimate, not a certified population MI; no pure-amorphous claim. Publish omitted mass/stratum/parent support.
loss: L=-mean_i sum_h q(h|V_i) [t(E_i,h)-logsumexp_{j in group(i)} t(E_j,h)]. Log and normalize separately for each HARD h before q average. H conditional on V, marginal H and I=H-H|V in bits from uniform-anchor plugin, actual hard rate and full state frequencies; soft expected and hard log8-L separately in nats. State q never passed to critic. No supervised target training.
optimizer: Adam beta=.9,.999 eps=1e-8. Both branches LR .0008/sqrt(1+updates/1024); no extra regularization/entropy targets/search. Shared seed-indexed draws within objective and nested parent sets, rng seeds 6101,6102,6103, finalists also 6104 and 6105. Architecture initialization streams separated for encoder and critic. Matched loss/updates/batch size.
ladder: Nested first 256/1024/4096 parents with all 64 anchors. All four arms x three paired starts: 512,1024,2048,4096,8192 cumulative updates. Record fixed fit and tune eval at every doubling including both unconditional and conditional, hard and expected. Fixed 4096 groups of 8 per eval law per split, shared across arms/seeds/rungs on same support, whole-anchor marginal rate. Blocks of parents delete-one-block grouped with removal of every eval tuple touching deleted block, approximate jackknife (not inferential assessment). Record raw gradient norms, CPU/wall. No HOLD. Compare arms at common largest reached rung/size only (at least 4096 updates for nomination; otherwise explicitly inadequate). Ties by affine then unconditional then smaller seed for exact equality.
nomination: Same metric for EVERY model: arithmetic mean of hard uniform and hard matched finite-candidate nats on independent tune; all scores, including negative, carried. No comparison of differently conditioned objectives' own training losses. Choose architecture per objective by median of three paired tune metrics at largest common 4096-parent rung, then extend BOTH objective finalists at matched depth/compute; add seeds 6104/6105 on finalists. At equal deepest shared depth choose one finalist by median of its shared seed set; give paired seeds in increasing seed order to rule selection, not the luckiest seed. No physical downstream scores choose representation or tune critic. Fit diagnostics same metric, separate data from tune; stratification support recorded separately.
depth: Finalist doublings 16384/32768/65536 if useful improvement not excluded and measured wall budget allows both finalists/paired starts. Finalist stops at two successive doublings where BOTH upper 95% development improvement estimates <.001 nat (prespecified sensitivity proxy, not equated with MSE), or 65536, or measured wall-cost cap; for paired gains use seed mean with max of paired-seed t halfwidth and delete-parent-block pseudo-SE halfwidth. Do not mistake noisy/precision-limited changes for plateau; if capped while rising label compute-limited. No alternate temperature, new model or feature after outcomes. We elect NO additional capacity/negative/K diagnostic. If budget tight prioritize matched arm coverage to 4096 then 8192, finalist seed spread, then depth; model freeze must leave time for rule/forecast and honor parent's earlier stop or 20:10:25Z.
fixed_controls: HeroRule's fit_control/hard_control with six fixed raw-center codes (site, composition, coordination, crystal, random_affine, random_tanh); evaluate all on 4096 fit parents using same pair samplers, critic capacity, Adam schedule, seeds and screening depth as learned arms. Train critic on frozen hard code (deployed argmax), publish actual hard entropy and imbalance; not candidate nominations. Careful distinctions in achievable rate. Rules may use fit-only thresholds; no tune calibration. Compare to hard learned score. No information about test interiors.
synthetic: Fixed two nuisance patterns Z; uniform binary central feature X is A occupying index 0 vs index 26, swapped with B. Other states B except three fixed vacancies at indices 1,2,3 when Z=1. Center atom, inventories, internal occupancy degree/count are X-independent; S differs by Z. Remote ternary Y is orientation of A vs vacancy on two opposing x=+/-4 faces, other sites B, P(Y agrees X)=(1+rho)/2. Same nuisance law across independent pseudo-parents. rho=.1 (MSE oracle gain .01), .6 (.36), and within-Z paired permutation null of strong law with independent fit/eval permutations. 131072 fit pseudo-parents and 131072 independent eval pseudo-parents per law, exactly one anchor each. Exogenous nuisance/ordinary central/site and global shell counts predict zero. Exact contrastive oracle sum binomial(7,.5) for negative matches and both positive possibilities, hard oracle and MSE ratio rho^2 reported alongside sample. Full production training engine 4 arms, one fixed seed 6101, 8192 updates each, log doublings. No target label touches gradients. For MSE, evaluate learned q and exp(t)/E_Y exp(t) on exhaustive known finite alphabet; compute E[X|h] from equally weighted central prototypes then predict X by normalized p(h|Y); evaluate EXTERNALLY on held-out pseudo-parents, no supervised parameter fit. Holdout finite-candidate estimate uses disjoint 8-parent groups within stratum (and unconditional groups) and whole group sampling error. Report exact population scores side by side. Thresholds for EACH arm at 8192: weak expected common nats >.001 and weak learned normalized MSE gain >.004 with heldout 95% lower>0; strong expected nats >.06 and MSE gain>.15 with lower>0; combined strong-vs-null and weak-vs-null positive, shuffled learned gain <=.002 and expected nats <=.0015 (do not demand a lucky sign or exclude zero). Binary swap is affine-representable, no XOR gate for affine. Preserve failure receipt; synthetic-only diagnosis restricted to comparing exact prototype oracle, analytical gradient vs finite differences and sampling law; never adjust physical arms silently or reissue a gate. Frozen training until controls and lineage pass and Main authorizes. Estimate cost from full-dimensional numerical timings, not a fabricated physical run.
